senses.en: Father dug up sweet potatoes and threw them away.
The third time he threw (a branch) at her head.
This stuff will be thrown away by a person.
The sweet potato was thrown away by a person.

records.text: ana u paxazing apuan nu yu rahan

senses.en: Don't forget about the elders' words.
full (of a rice grain), not empty

citation.label: 《巴宰語詞典》p.322，xedang- 條下派生詞

senses.en: fully grown as of a grain

《巴宰語詞典》p.322，xepes- 條下派生詞

senses.en: to put on more clothes, to pile up (rice sacks)

citation.label: 《巴宰語詞典》p.322，xepexep- 條下派生詞

senses.en: Put on more (clothes or rice sacks)!
to apply force to exert, to bear down

citation.label: 《巴宰語詞典》p.322，xe'el- 條下派生詞

senses.en: is bearing down (as when defecating or giving birth)

senses.en: Tie the dustbin unto the shoulders!

senses.en: The cow will be tied by me.
Awi will tie the dog tomorrow.
to tie up an animal to a stake or the like

citation.label: 《巴宰語詞典》p.322–323，xe'et- 條下派生詞

senses.en: The carabaos were tied by me.

records.text: xe'eden ni awi lia ki wazu

senses.en: The dog was tied by Awi.

records.text: xine'edan ni awi lia ki wazu

senses.en: The dog has been tied by Awi.

citation.label: 《巴宰語詞典》p.322–323，xe'et- 條下派生詞

senses.en: The trees are used to tie carabaos.
